descriptionChirho: An Attic dialectal conditional particle meaning 'otherwise' or 'if not', introducing an alternative or contrary-to-fact scenario (Rom 11:6, 11:22; 2 Cor 11:16; Heb 9:17, 10:2; Matt 6:1; Luke 10:6; 2 Cor 5:10 v.l.). Multilingual translations uniformly confirm a single sense: Spanish 'no/de otra manera', Hindi 'nahin to' (नहीं तो), Arabic 'fa-la/la' (فَلَا/لا), Korean 'animyeon' (아니면/아니라도), and Swahili 'sivyo/la sivyo'. The S66287 'even if' occurrence is simply a contextual shade of the same conditional negation particle, not a lexically distinct meaning.
